searchText: What is the easiest ETH2 client to get up and running on a local private testnet? Or a public testnet I suppose, if ETH on such testnets is readily available. Pyrmont is the current testnet, easy enough to get going. The deposit contract is in goerli so you need ETH on there (I can send you some of you don't have any) Private network, prysm has an interop mode that can be spun up easily but it's more for beacon node and validator client testing than a general net I can probably make goerli work. What ETH2 client is easiest to get up and running on Windows (ideally without a dev environment)? Haven't used Windows myself, but I believe that lighthouse comes as a single binary so that would be pretty easy. Bleh, appears that Lighthouse only works if you have WSL, so doesn't meet my "no dev env needed" requirement. Bleh, it appears that all 4 require dev environments. 😢 No docker or similar available to you? This isn't for me, it is for training purposes. Minimizing dependencies will make training go *way* smoother, so I was hoping to find an ETH2 client that didn't require any sort of dev environment (just a base Windows installation). Sorry, in that case out of my area of expertise. Appreciate the help none the less, you at least pointed me in the right direction. 🙂 <@!301186049323958275> If you need native windows binaries, we do have them https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/releases/download/v1.0.4/beacon-chain-v1.0.4-windows-amd64.exe
